capabilities: Install 1,441 SRD 5.2.1 rules notes and 12 Bases views into chosen vault folders
Browse spells, bestiary, items and other rules as catalogs built from note properties
Create, edit and level up character notes generated from the rules
Roll character checks into Atlas VTT scenes through the Atlas VTT plugin
Create campaign and session notes with an activity log and encounters
extras: Unofficial community extension, not endorsed by Wizards of the Coast, Atlas VTT or Atlas Online, and not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Desktop only (Obsidian 1.11.4+); no phones or tablets. Notes are CC-BY 4.0 and about 94% of prose sentences were verified against the SRD PDF, so it is not a word-for-word copy. Makes one optional, privacy-neutral update-check request to raw.githubusercontent.com that can be switched off.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to get D&D 5e SRD rules as linked, browsable notes or to build and roll game characters from them.

relations.evidence: Rolls go through the Atlas VTT plugin when it is installed.

summary: SRD 5.2.1 plugin that installs the rules as linked notes with Bases catalogs, builds D&D characters, and rolls them into Atlas VTT scenes.
